title: Find the Kth Largest Integer in the Array
summary: Given an array of string integers without leading zeros, identify and return the string representing the kth largest integer.
statement: Given an array of string integers without leading zeros, identify and return the string representing the kth largest integer. Treat duplicates as distinct for ranking purposes.
constraints: nums contains 1 through 10000 distinct strings representing positive integers without leading zeros; each has at most 100 digits.
Order values numerically without requiring fixed-width machine integers.
Return the kth largest original string.
hints: Without leading zeros, more digits always means a larger positive integer; equal-length strings compare lexicographically.
Sort by the pair (length,string) in descending order.
The key exactly reproduces numeric ordering for canonical decimal strings without converting values of unbounded size.
editorial: The key exactly reproduces numeric ordering for canonical decimal strings without converting values of unbounded size.

tests.explanation: In descending numeric order the values are ten, seven, six, and three, so the fourth is three.
The descending order is twenty-one, twelve, two, one; the third value is two.
